item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently sets apart and reserves specified federal lands as a national monument and imposes an off-road vehicle prohibition; those legal consequences arise from the proclamation itself.","evidence":"there are hereby set apart and reserved as the Grand Canyon-Parashant National Monument"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The provision assigns cooperative and primary management responsibilities to the National Park Service and Bureau of Land Management and directs continued lease administration under existing law and policy; it organizes ongoing agency management rather than itself changing legal rights.","evidence":"The National Park Service and the Bureau of Land Management shall manage the monument cooperatively"}]}
